name: PROSPERITY, AND THE HOLE
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE CLAIM MARKER
LOOK_AT: A stake with a number on it. Beyond it, forty feet of land that is legally, indisputably mine.
The number is painted on with confidence and very little paint.
It leans. I have straightened it twice and it has gone back to leaning, which I respect as a position.
LISTEN_TO: Wind. It is not impressed either.
The stake creaks in the wind like a man trying to remember something.
Wind again. It comes through here on its way to somewhere better.

LOOK_AT: Prosperity. Named by a liar, bought by a fool, and correct the entire time. There is a sermon in that and Sowerby cannot have it.

overrides.PUSH: Mine now, lean and all. I have decided the lean is jaunty.
overrides.TALK_TO: 'Prosperity,' I told it, 'you and I are going to be the punchline of something.' I was righter than I knew.

subjects.name: THE MUD
LOOK_AT: Approximately forty percent mud, thirty percent rock, and thirty percent a substance I have not yet identified.
Having stood in it, I can report on the unidentified thirty percent. It is cold, and it is personal.
This is the mud I own. I keep expecting to feel differently about it than about other mud. I do not.
LISTEN_TO: Wet. Working at it.
It sucks at my boot as I lift it. Possessive, for something I bought.
A slow settling. It has nowhere else to be, and neither, it turns out, do I.

overrides.USE: I did use it. I filed it. It is the most administrated mud in the territory.

subjects.name: THE HOLE
LOOK_AT: A hole. Forty feet of my property goes down into it and does not come back.
The edges are old and smooth. Whatever dug this was in no hurry.
Forty feet of my land, and this is the only part of it that has shown any initiative.
LISTEN_TO: Air. Moving. It's warmer than the day.
Air. Moving. It's warmer than the day.
Air. Moving. It's warmer than the day.

LOOK_AT: The hole. The warm air. I evicted a raccoon from the front door of a fortune and apologized to neither of us.
LISTEN_TO: Air. Moving. Warmer than the day. The same words as always; I am only now hearing what they were saying.

overrides.CLOSE: You cannot close a hole. You can only fill it, and I have nothing to spare, including — on some mornings — the inclination.
overrides.TALK_TO: I said good morning down it. The echo said it back warmer than the town does.
overrides.OPEN: Vacant, per the eviction. The warm air keeps it aired. Best-ventilated address I own.

subjects.name: THE RACCOON
LOOK_AT: He is in my hole. He was in my hole before it was my hole, which he clearly regards as decisive.
He has arranged the hole to his satisfaction. There is a pine cone positioned with real intent.
We have looked at each other for some time. He is winning, in the sense that he is comfortable.
LISTEN_TO: Breathing. Slowly. In a way I would describe as editorial.
A small, contented grinding. He is eating something, and it was mine.
He is breathing at me again. I have been reviewed and found tenantable.

overrides.PICK_UP: No. He is in residence, and I am not his landlord in any sense he recognizes.
overrides.PUSH: I am not going to push a raccoon further into a hole he already likes. That is encouragement.
overrides.USE: He is not a tool. He is barely a tenant.

subjects.name: CLAIM ONE'S BOUNDARY
LOOK_AT: Somewhere past that stake is the most famous piece of ground in the territory. It looks exactly like this piece of ground.
A boundary stake, older than mine and sunk deeper. Someone meant it.
On that side, the most valuable ground in the territory. On this side, mine. The raccoon cannot tell the difference, and has not tried.
LISTEN_TO: The same. Exactly the same.
Wind, crossing from his land to mine without a survey.
Exactly the same. I have listened for the difference twice now, and the difference is the price.

subjects.name: THE CREEK
LOOK_AT: A creek, low and brown, running past the foot of my claim and declining to stop.
Men upstream pan it every day. By the time it reaches me it has been thoroughly searched.
It is the only thing on my property that is going anywhere.
LISTEN_TO: Water over stones, talking to itself the way water does, cheerfully and without content.
The same water. It has said nothing new since I arrived, which makes it the most reliable voice in the district.
A pan scraping, far upstream. Somebody hoping. The creek carries that down too.

subjects.name: THE RIDGE
LOOK_AT: The ridge above the claims, bare to the sky. From up there, I am told, you can see the whole district and none of its prospects.
There is a path up it, worn by men going to look at what they cannot have.
It was here before the town and expects to be here after. It has the patience of a creditor.
LISTEN_TO: Wind along the top, steady as a held note.
The wind again, a little sharp. Somebody should see to that.
Nothing coming down from it. Whatever is up there is keeping it to itself.
